title: Upload a certificate for {domain}
help: Use a certificate you bought or were given. It is checked before it is installed: it must be for this domain, not expired, and match the key.
note: It is not renewed automatically: you get a notification 30, 7 and 1 days before it expires. To go back to a free certificate, use Reinstall SSL.
fileTooLarge: That file is too large to be a certificate or a key.
